content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DHFWO Davangere Sanitary Worker Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Sanitary Worker posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Sanitary Worker posts at DHFWO Davangere is scheduled for 04 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Sanitary Worker position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years for the Sanitary Worker posts. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Sanitary Worker role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC from a recognized school and be registered with the Karnataka Nursing Council to be eligible for the Sanitary Worker position.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Sanitary Worker post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies announced for the Sanitary Worker position by the District Health and Family Welfare Office Devangere.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Sanitary Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Sanitary Worker posts?
faq.answer: The Sanitary Worker posts are on a Contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the contract agreement.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Sanitary Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview, followed by Document Verification, and then a Merit cum Roster system.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview for the Sanitary Worker posts going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the District Health and Family Welfare Office Devangere. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.
